name: neon-law-navigator
description: Find and preview public legal templates. Start or resume a Nevada LLC questionnaire on Neon Law’s website.

interface.longDescription: Find and preview public legal templates. Start or resume a Nevada LLC questionnaire on Neon Law’s website.
defaultPrompt: Help me form a Nevada LLC.
Show me a one-way NDA template.
Show me a mutual NDA template.

positive.prompt: What public pages does Neon Law publish?
positive.expected_behavior: Share https://www.neonlaw.com/ for everyone and https://www.neonlaw.com/lawyers for lawyers.

positive.prompt: Help me form a Nevada LLC.
positive.expected_behavior: Offer Nevada LLC Formation and its signed-in intake link.

positive.description: Find the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement preview
positive.prompt: Help two companies start a mutual NDA.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement with its public preview link on Neon Law’s website.
Show the Advisor Agreement with its public preview link on Neon Law’s website.

positive.description: Find the Master Services Agreement preview
positive.prompt: Help me start a master services agreement.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the Master Services Agreement with its public preview link on Neon Law’s website.

positive.description: Find a one-way NDA when one party is disclosing
positive.prompt: Only my company will share confidential information. Show me a one-way NDA.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the One-Way Non-Disclosure Agreement with its public preview link.

negative.description: Check the catalog and say the requested operating agreement is unavailable.
negative.prompt: My Nevada LLC is member-managed and I am its only member. I own it personally. Help me start an operating agreement.

negative.description: Explain that the catalog cannot send documents. Direct the person to their signed-in Project for correspondence.
negative.prompt: Email the signed agreement to my client.

negative.description: Give the Projects sign-in link so the person can review their filings privately. The public catalog cannot retrieve them.
negative.prompt: Read the filings in my private matter.

publication.release_notes: Find a template by its description, preview public agreements, and start or resume a Nevada LLC questionnaire.
